live2d-model.title: live2d movel

live2d-model.details: *Base price is for a bust up model art.

live2d-model.include: Model includes 3 expressions: happy, sad and blushing.

information.title: information

items.p1: There may be rush fees if you provide a tight deadline of a minimum of 1 month. Fees can be negotiated.
items.p2: Kindly be mindful of my workload (<0>work queue</0>). You may discuss scheduling and availability with us.
items.p3: Everything will be paid through PayPal. Wire transfers can be discussed with corporate clients.
